email_subject: Application - Social Media Manager at Ariad
email_body:
Dear Ariad Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Social Media Manager role on behalf of your global consumer electronics client. With hands-on experience in digital marketing, content planning, and social media coordination, I'm eager to bring my skills to a dynamic, data-driven team.

At Episto, I manage SEO and content for client websites, and on my own project mirook.com, I've built and optimized a WordPress site with social media integration. I'm comfortable with analytics tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush, and I'm quick to learn new platforms such as Sprinklr or Later. My background in front-end development gives me a technical edge in understanding digital ecosystems.

I'm passionate about social media trends and community engagement, and I thrive in fast-paced environments. I'd love to contribute to building a culturally relevant brand for a global electronics leader.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear Ariad Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Social Media Manager position at Ariad, working with a global leader in consumer electronics. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, content creation, and social media coordination, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to a brand that shapes technology and culture.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage SEO and content for client websites, which includes keyword research, content publishing, and performance reporting using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. I also have hands-on experience with WordPress, Elementor, and social media integration, as demonstrated in my project mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page site and integrated Instagram and Facebook. This blend of technical and creative skills allows me to understand platform dynamics and optimize content for engagement.

While my formal experience in social media management is growing, I have a genuine passion for social platforms and a deep curiosity about trends and online communities. I am confident in my ability to learn quickly, as shown by my proactive approach to mastering new tools and technologies. I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines analytical thinking with creative storytelling—areas where I excel. I am eager to develop creative briefs, coordinate cross-channel campaigns, and collaborate with international stakeholders to drive impactful social media strategies.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and work fluently in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level. I am excited about the prospect of joining Ariad's network of digital consultants and contributing to a collaborative, data-driven team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your client.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
